description: Use when a user asks about a mortgage or house payment, e.g. "what is the monthly payment on a $400,000 house with 20% down at 6.5%?", "how much interest will I pay on a $300,000 mortgage?" or "15 vs 30 year mortgage payment". Monthly principal and interest for a fixed rate loan, total interest, first payment split, balance after 5 years and the same loan on a 15 or 30 year term. Optional property tax, home insurance, HOA and PMI give the full monthly payment. Example: $320,000 at 6.5% for 30 years = $2,022.62 a month.

annual_rate.description: Yearly mortgage rate in percent, e.g. 6.5.

down_payment_percent.description: Down payment as a percent of the price, e.g. 20 (instead of down_payment).

hoa_monthly.description: HOA dues per month in USD (default 0).

home_insurance_annual.description: Home insurance per year in USD (default 0).

home_price.description: Home price in USD (or send loan_amount).

loan_amount.description: Amount borrowed in USD (instead of home_price and down payment).

pmi_annual_percent.description: PMI as a yearly percent of the loan, e.g. 0.5 (default 0).

property_tax_annual.description: Property tax per year in USD (default 0).

name: calculate_mortgage_payment
title: Mortgage payment calculator
